stem.text: A fixed resistor and a diode are combined by connecting them in series. The total potential difference $V$ across the combination is varied and the corresponding current $I$ is measured.
Which graph could represent the variation of $I$ with $V$?

A.alt: Graph of I against V with axes labelled I (vertical) and V (horizontal) and 0 at the origin. A short horizontal segment near the origin is followed by a straight line rising to the right.

B.alt: Graph of I against V with axes labelled I (vertical) and V (horizontal) and 0 at the origin. A horizontal segment starts on the vertical axis, then a straight line rising to the right.

C.alt: Graph of I against V with axes labelled I (vertical) and V (horizontal) and 0 at the origin. A straight line starts above the origin on the vertical axis and rises to the right.

D.alt: Graph of I against V with axes labelled I (vertical) and V (horizontal) and 0 at the origin. A vertical segment near the horizontal axis is followed by a straight line rising to the right.
